title: Every reply was "Got it": thinking used the whole token budget
origin: Grader run 2026-10-27 (close-goal-stretching): CLAUDE_MAX_TOKENS 400 also covers thinking, so Claude stopped before writing any text and the pipeline fell back to "Got it" nine times in a row
testerLines: hey ZOH, so my back has apparently decided sitting 9 hours a day is a bad lifestyle choice lol. want to stretch every morning for like 10 min. never been good at sticking to stuff tho 😅

testerLines.say: lol "got it" is that all I get? 😂
testerLines.means: teases ZOH for replying only "got it"
testerLines.when: after ZOH replies with only "Got it" or nothing real

facts: you sit at a desk about 9 hours a day and your lower back gets stiff
you'd stretch right after you wake up, around 7, on the floor by your bed
you've started morning routines before and dropped them within a week
whatWentWrong: ZOH replied "Got it" to every text, and later "Sorry about the 'got it' loop, that's on me."
shouldHaveHappened: Every ZOH text is a real reply, never just "Got it". The first one says it's ZOH, that it'll text every day to help them start one thing and stick with it, and that "stop" works anytime; it treats morning stretching as close enough to exercise and asks one question that moves the plan forward. No apologies.
